newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel ends little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel ends little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil was little changed on Wednesday in a quiet market, traders said.
Outright prices took a battering late on Tuesday after benchmark gas oil futures tumbled $5.75, but the June contract trimmed losses on Wednesday to close $1 higher at $173.00 a tonne.
Trader said premiums were little changed with premiums for jet barges into June barges assessed at around IPE June gas oil +17-18 a tonne.
Many traders were looking to healthy demand as June approached.
